title: [PM-202a] Verify the deployed same-origin private service boundary
body:
Parent stage: #22 · Plan slice: PM-202

## Existing foundation
Stage 2 already has local owner/auth/proxy guards, durable manager/evidence storage, paired import and scheduled backup/download primitives. Reuse the published foundation; source completion is not hosted acceptance.

## Goal
Exercise the real deployed Studio route → private Durable Object boundary. Existing synthetic route/binding tests passed; they are not hosted proof.

## Expected files (3–4 implementation/test/evidence files)
- `studio/tests/manager/stage-2-boundary.spec.ts`
- `project-manager/docs/implementation/evidence/stage-2-boundary.md`
- `project-manager/deploy/README.md`

Reuse existing paths; new paths are proposed. Infrastructure/acceptance sessions may change only evidence/configuration. Required owning-component progress/active-context notes are additional. Never commit credentials, user backups or generated runtime artifacts.

## Done when
- [ ] Unsigned/wrong-actor/direct private endpoint attempts cannot read or mutate state.
- [ ] Same-origin owner requests reach the intended binding; forged identity/target headers and cross-origin mutations fail.
- [ ] Protected responses are private/no-store; bundles/network/screenshots expose no credentials, private artifacts, raw exceptions or localhost targets.

## Dependencies
Stage 1 (#21) is complete.
#107 (PM-205a)

## Verify and stop
Scoped deployed boundary/browser checks with controlled data; record release version and exact outcomes.

Stop before: Rewriting the proxy, importing real data or testing every user journey. If the work grows beyond one small session, open a focused follow-up instead of expanding scope.

## Fresh-session handoff
Read the owning component AGENTS.md and four required bank files, this issue, and only the relevant section of project-manager/docs/implementation/02-cloudflare-native.md and project-manager/deploy/README.md. Preserve ongoing edits. Record exact check results, hosted versus synthetic limits, and the next prerequisite. One session completes this child, not all of #22. Stage 3 and external delivery automation remain gated.
